title: Use short compiler scratch and preserve startup errors in the Windows cleanup probe
outcome: The Windows release-order probe follows the guardian's short repository-local compiler scratch convention and preserves an original process-start failure.
acceptance: Allocate compiler scratch under the short guarded repository-local layout rather than the deep fixture Git-admin path, with owned cleanup and a representative long-root witness.
Guard probe finalization with a successful-start flag so a failed Process.Start retains its original error.
